name: openspec_merge_pass_progress
description: Deterministic decision step, replacing a JSON_JQ_TRANSFORM.

fanOutput.description: FORK_JOIN_DYNAMIC output map (taskReferenceName -> {output: {...}} or the result dict directly). Non-dict values are treated as {}.

readyIds.description: Artifact ids selected in this pass (from openspec_select_ready). Non-list values are treated as [].

prevGenerated.description: Artifact ids generated in prior passes. Non-list values are treated as [].

prevFiles.description: Files changed across prior passes. Non-list values are treated as [].

prevCost.description: Cumulative USD cost from prior passes. Non-numeric values are treated as 0.

prevTokens.description: Cumulative token usage from prior passes. Non-numeric values are treated as 0.

generated.description: Sorted, deduplicated union of prevGenerated and readyIds.

filesChanged.description: Deduplicated union of prevFiles and every filesChanged entry from this pass's fan-out results (order-preserving; only added when readyIds is non-empty).

costUsd.description: prevCost plus the sum of costUsd across this pass's fan-out results (unchanged when readyIds is empty).

tokenUsed.description: prevTokens plus the sum of tokenUsed across this pass's fan-out results (unchanged when readyIds is empty).
